goal: Strengthen the existing AI lifecycle archive from source-linked product history into a deterministic lifecycle registry that follows shutdown, deprecation and major change through export, migration, replacement or successor outcomes where evidence supports them.
implementation_rule: Audit current main first and reuse existing record detail, event/category indexes, basic search, and basic Stats. Implement only verified gaps. Schema changes require the Stage 2 representative-record decision. Each runtime stage requires repository checks green, merge, and production verification where public output changes.
